title: Gyeran Mari Korean Rolled Omelette

seo.title: Gyeran Mari (Korean Rolled Omelette) Recipe | Easy & Authentic
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make delicious Gyeran Mari, the classic Korean rolled omelette! Our easy, authentic recipe brings this beloved breakfast or side dish to your kitchen.

description: Gyeran Mari is a beloved Korean rolled omelette, a simple yet elegant dish perfect for breakfast, lunchboxes, or as a side dish to any Korean meal. Its delicate layers of fluffy egg, often studded with colorful vegetables, offer a delightful texture and mild, savory flavor. This versatile dish is not only delicious but also visually appealing, making it a staple in Korean home cooking.

instructions.title: Prepare the Egg Mixture
instructions.text: Crack the eggs into a medium bowl and whisk them thoroughly until the yolks and whites are fully combined and slightly frothy. Add the finely chopped carrot, green onion, yellow onion (if using), salt, and black pepper. Mix well to ensure all ingredients are evenly distributed in the egg mixture.

instructions.title: Heat the Pan
instructions.text: Heat a non-stick rectangular or round pan over low to medium-low heat. Add a small amount of vegetable oil and sesame oil, about 1/2 teaspoon total, and spread it evenly across the pan using a paper towel or brush. The pan should be lightly greased, not pooling with oil.

instructions.title: Pour the First Layer
instructions.text: Pour approximately one-quarter to one-third of the egg mixture into the heated pan. Tilt the pan to spread the egg mixture into a thin, even layer, covering the entire bottom surface. Cook until the edges are set and the top is mostly cooked but still slightly wet.

instructions.title: Start Rolling
instructions.text: Once the first layer is mostly set, gently push the cooked egg from one end of the pan towards the other, rolling it tightly into a log. Leave a small portion of the rolled egg at one end of the pan to act as a base for the next layer. You can use a spatula or chopsticks for this.

instructions.title: Continue Layering and Rolling
instructions.text: Slide the rolled egg to one side of the pan. Lightly re-grease the empty portion of the pan if needed. Pour another portion of the egg mixture into the empty space, allowing it to slightly run underneath the rolled egg. Cook until this new layer is mostly set, then roll the existing log over the fresh egg layer, continuing to form a thicker roll.

instructions.title: Repeat and Finish Cooking
instructions.text: Repeat the layering and rolling process with the remaining egg mixture until all the egg has been used and you have one large, thick rolled omelette. Once fully rolled, gently press the omelette on all sides to ensure it is cooked through and holds its shape. Remove from heat.

instructions.title: Slice and Serve
instructions.text: Carefully transfer the Gyeran Mari to a cutting board. Let it cool for a few minutes to set before slicing. Using a sharp knife, cut the rolled omelette into 1-inch thick slices. Arrange them on a plate and serve warm or at room temperature as a breakfast item, side dish, or for lunchboxes.

tips: For a perfectly smooth omelette, strain the egg mixture through a fine-mesh sieve after whisking to remove any chalazae or lumps, ensuring a uniform texture.
Use a non-stick rectangular pan if possible for easier rolling. If using a round pan, just ensure even spreading. Keep the heat low to prevent browning and allow for gradual cooking.
To achieve clean, even slices, let the rolled omelette cool slightly for a few minutes before cutting. This helps the layers set and prevents tearing.
